Learning from Demonstration

Exploration of robot learning methods to reproduce manipulation tasks from human demonstrations.

Project overview

This project explores Learning from Demonstration (LfD) for robotic manipulation. The goal is to use demonstrations collected through a leader-follower robotic setup as data for training and evaluating policies that reproduce a task.

Engineering activities

  • Use of a leader-follower robotic system to collect demonstrations.
  • Recording and organization of robot observations and actions.
  • Exploration of imitation-learning approaches for manipulation tasks.
  • Evaluation of trained policies through robotic execution.

Technologies

SO-ARM101, LeRobot, Python and machine-learning-based imitation learning.
